scripts.build:web: node scripts/prepare-web.mjs && esbuild native/location-entry.js --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=native-location.js && cp native-location.js www/native-location.js && node scripts/make-icons.mjs

scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
